newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 summit to take up Japan trade issue - paper.
newsitem.headline: G7 summit to take up Japan trade issue - paper.

text.p: The Group of Seven (G7) industrialised nations will call on Japan to prevent its trade surplus from growing at the group's June 20-22 summit meeting in Denver, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Friday, quoting sources close to summit participants in Washington.

The United States, confident after achieving stable economic growth and moving closer to balancing its budget, wants Japan and European countries to stabilise their economies, the business daily said in its evening edition.

The G7 is also expected to issue an economic declaration that will include some steps to stabilise foreign exchange rates to cope with a weaker yen and uncertainties surrounding the European single currency plan, the Nikkei quoted the sources as saying.

Some steps to strengthen monetary supervision in developing countries will be incorporated in the declaration in the wake of recent financial turmoil in the Czech Republic and Thailand, the paper added.
